adaptations: Methods become free functions with an explicit borrowed Core; Self constants and self method calls reference Core.
Public wrapper calls the copied scalar body rather than private CPU feature dispatch.
Private c_min is copied with its exact conditional semantics.

semantic_changes.reason: Preserve original TA-Lib C0.8.1 signed-zero short stores.

nonchanges: Parameter guards, default sentinels, lookback, index ranges, checked input/output slices, recurrence comparisons/order and .mul_add expressions retained.
Official Core .sarext_lookback and .minus_dm remain public API calls.
performance_boundary: The copied safe scalar body cannot use the original private target_feature FMA dispatch. Portable code may call libm fma; same-runner final-code CI is required.
routing: Official typed Core call first. Inspect only range.count written values for negative-zero bits. If present, replay the two-store compatibility scalar into the same initialized buffer and require identical OutRange; no blanket zero normalization.
